newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-TWO ARRESTED OVER WORLD CUP VENUE IRREGULARITIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO ARRESTED OVER WORLD CUP VENUE IRREGULARITIES.

text.p: Two men have been arrested and placed under investigation for fraud in public office and other irregularities over building work on the 1998 World Cup soccer stadium in the northern city of Lens.
Judicial sources said on Friday architect Milan Martic and researcher Max Tarterat had both been held in custody.

Work on the Felix Bollaert stadium, home of first division Lens, is scheduled to be completed in May, 1997 in time to host the match between Brazil and England in the four-team World Cup warm-up Tournament of France in June.
